name: @flaky-tests-demo/integrations-swift
description: Swift Testing upload wiring: a minimal suite plus the post-processing its JUnit output needs.

scripts.test: mkdir -p test-results && swift test --xunit-output test-results/swift.xml; status=$?; node ./junit-add-file-attribute.mjs test-results/swift-swift-testing.xml; exit $status
scripts.test:declarations: mkdir -p test-results-declarations && swift test --xunit-output test-results-declarations/swift.xml; status=$?; node ./junit-add-file-attribute.mjs --timestamps-only test-results-declarations/swift-swift-testing.xml; exit $status
scripts.test:xcresult: rm -rf test-results-xcresult && mkdir -p test-results-xcresult && xcodebuild test -scheme SwiftTestingUpload -destination 'platform=macOS' -resultBundlePath test-results-xcresult/SwiftTestingUpload.xcresult
